briefdescription.para: Create a new sequence object with the given definition.

detaileddescription.para: Note, on success the sequence definition is assigned to the new sequence and will be freed automatically when the sequence is destroyed so it must be allocated with malloc().

briefdescription.para: Destroy a sequence and its definition.

detaileddescription.para: Return 0 on success, -1 on memory allocation failure.

briefdescription.para: Update the sequence if the given value is newer than the last generated value.

detaileddescription.para: Return 0 on success, -1 on memory allocation failure.

On success, return 0 and assign the next sequence to
, otherwise return -1 and set diag. The function may fail for two reasons:
sequence isn't cyclic and has reached its limit
memory allocation failure

briefdescription.para: Check whether or not the current user can be granted access to the sequence.
Create an iterator over sequence data.

detaileddescription.para: The iterator creates a snapshot of sequence data and walks over it, i.e. updates done after the iterator was open are invisible. Used to make a snapshot of _sequence_data space.

briefdescription.para: Get last element of given sequence.
